reaction: The ordinary scene is a satisfying way to bring the body systems together, though most of that connection is explained in the final passage.

mostWorthwhile.text: Taking the bite was the strongest moment: the final passage connects eating and drinking with breathing, digestion and circulation in one continuing activity.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the cup was straightforward but contributed little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The final picture description follows the drink beyond swallowing, through the gut and blood toward cells. The time-separated insets help make the delay clear.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each served the stated goal. After the first choice, however, each combination was the only one offered.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing if another chapter offered more meaningful choices. This ending brought the systems together clearly, but the sequence was predictable.
